messages:
maria: Heads-up — Silverpine private rollout scheduled tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go and a firm version pin for the Dedicated pool.

suresh: Which runtime + model are we pinning?

maria: Proposal: inference-runtime:1.12.0 and model sp-llama-13b-q4_0-v1.2 (quantized) — reduces mem/cost. Canary at 5% for first 15m, then promote if stable. Fallback policy -> hosted-std if capacity issues.

kai: Any recent regressions in decoding? latency numbers?

maria: Benchmarks in the PR: https://intra.redwood/bench/SPR-198 (private). P99 ~210ms @ seq512 warmed, median ~45ms. No OOM on 48G machines in synthetic load.

observability-bot: New dashboard created: /silverpine/rollouts/1951234567 (live metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, infra-util).

olga: Security check — do we need to rotate tenant KMS keys or update ACLs for this deploy?

maria: No KMS rotation required for this patch. Access controls unchanged. I'll add the deployment runbook note anyway.

jess: Oncall here — suggested rollback thresholds: error-rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency >700ms for 5m. Also enable emergency toggle on the Console route. I'll monitor.

ops-oncall: Infra note: need 3 spare nodes in silverpine-dedicated-pool during the window for blue/green swap. Confirmed capacity reservation.

suresh: Can we also pin model weights digest in the config? Prevent accidental drift.

maria: Good call — adding sha256:abcd1234... to deployment spec.

maria: Requesting final approvals: @suresh (eng), @olga (security), @ops-oncall (infra), @jess (oncall). Reply with ":+1:" to approve.

suresh: :+1: (peer code + perf OK)

olga: :+1: security reviewed

ops-oncall: :+1: capacity reserved, alerts hooked

jess: :+1: I'll be watching, escalation path in runbook.

maria: Great — starting scheduled deploy. tagging release notes: silverpine-private-v1.2. Flagging for post-rollout evals.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Scheduled job queued: silverpine-private-v1.2 -> canary 5% on pool silverpine-dedicated-pool. runtime=inference-runtime:1.12.0, model=sp-llama-13b-q4_0-v1.2, model-sha=abcd1234. Triggered by maria.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Canary started — targets: 5% traffic, expected duration 15m. Monitoring endpoints: /dash/silverpine/1951234567

observability-bot: Canary metrics stream live. p99=230ms, error-rate=0.08%, cpu avg 64% on canary nodes.

jess: Seeing a small p95 bump, p99 still ok. hold for 10m then reassess.

maria: Noted. Ops: any IO spikes?

ops-oncall: IO normal. No node restarts. Spares holding.

maria: After 12m looks stable to me. Promote to 30%?

suresh: +1 promote to 30, watch for tokenization edgecases we saw last month.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Promotion initiated: canary -> 30% traffic. Controlled rollout in progress.

observability-bot: During promotion: p99 -> 260ms, error-rate 0.12%, transient tail. No service errors.

jess: Still below rollback threshold. continuing monitoring.

maria: OK rolling to 100% in 20m if no uptick. Anyone object?

olga: No objections from security.

ops-oncall: Capacity still good.

maria: Proceeding.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Final rollout: promoting to 100% on silverpine-dedicated-pool.

observability-bot: Post-rollout metrics (first 10m): p99 275ms, error-rate 0.15%, infra cpu 68%. All within SLOs.

jess: No signs of regressions. Marking as stable.

maria: Thanks all. Notes: pinned runtime+model sha, rollback thresholds documented, dashboard link + runbook attached to release ticket. Closing thread — please open an issues thread if you spot any user-facing regressions. :white_check_mark:

suresh: Adding a short release-note blurb and tagging in product.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Done. Canary->100% complete. Job 1951234567 finished.
